CCP_research_next_page = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_research_page < ccp_research_pages_last }
		}
		add_to_variable = { ccp_research_page = 1 }
		CCP_research_load_page = yes
	}
}

CCP_research_prev_page = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_research_page > 0 }
		}
		subtract_from_variable = { ccp_research_page = 1 }
		CCP_research_load_page = yes
	}
}

CCP_research_grant = {
	set_variable = { global.ccp_status = 14 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_research_folder = 1 }
		}
		CCP_research_grant_infantry_folder = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_research_folder = 2 }
		}
		CCP_research_grant_support_folder = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_research_folder = 3 }
		}
		CCP_research_grant_artillery_folder = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_research_folder = 4 }
		}
		CCP_research_grant_naval_folder = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_research_folder = 5 }
		}
		CCP_research_grant_air_techs_folder = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_research_folder = 6 }
		}
		CCP_research_grant_electronics_folder = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_research_folder = 7 }
		}
		CCP_research_grant_industry_folder = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_research_folder = 8 }
		}
		CCP_research_grant_CCP_RESEARCH_SPECIAL = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_research_folder = 9 }
		}
		CCP_research_grant_armour_folder = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_research_folder = 10 }
		}
		CCP_research_grant_bba_air_techs_folder = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_research_folder = 11 }
		}
		CCP_research_grant_mtgnavalfolder = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_research_folder = 12 }
		}
		CCP_research_grant_mtgnavalsupportfolder = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_research_folder = 13 }
		}
		CCP_research_grant_nsb_armour_folder = yes
	}
	CCP_mark_dirty = yes
}

CCP_research_grant_infantry_folder = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_research_selected = 0 }
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = CCP_RESEARCH_GRANT_TOOLTIP
		hidden_effect = {
			set_technology = { armored_car1 = 1 popup = no }
			set_variable = { global.ccp_status = 6 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
